NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE IS REQUIRED. ONLY ETERNAL CURIOSITY AND THE PLEASURE OF KNOWLEDGE. PLS KEEP UPDATED of any changes and updates on our WhatsApp Group: [Enjoy Philosophy Lisboa Group Access Link](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GYP2kvajg8j3BGejCd8xVm?mode=gi_t) We will learn, debate, enjoy and investigate philosophers and diverse themes from the philosophical perspective. Each reunion is structured as a conversation among all attendees about that day s philosopher softly moderated by the organizer. The conversation will kick-off from the very brief suggested reading providing easy access to all attendees both to the philosopher and the conversation. Let´s be greek and dive today on… **Ernst Bloch (1885–1977), who made hope the centre of a vast philosophical inquiry. His most important work, *The Principle of Hope*, asks a simple question: what does it mean that human beings continually imagine a life different from the one they presently inhabit?** **Bloch claims that hope is not merely a pleasant emotion or an optimistic belief that everything will eventually improve.** **Hope is an essential orientation towards possibilities that have not yet been realised.** **And as such, as guiding behaviour, shapes new realities.** **And therefore, Hope has an undefeatable political power.** **Human consciousness IS NOT imprisoned within the present: it anticipates, imagines and reaches beyond what already exists.** **This “Not-Yet”—our awareness that both ourselves and the world remain unfinished appears throughout ordinary life.** **The smallest daydream may contain an utopian impulse.** **In distinguishing an abstract hope that escapes into fantasy without confronting reality, from a Concrete hope, that is informed by the real possibilities and contradictions of the present, Bloch asks the fundamental philosophical question: WHAT - CAN - BE ?** **WHAT - IS - POSSIBLE ?** **And how humans, on their daily in and outs, ask and re-ask it in their decisions, this fundamental exploration.** **A better future is NOT guaranteed; but a hope that identifies what could become possible through knowledge, collective action and political struggle is the political tool through which humans can shape the world. Bloch calls this “learned hope”: hope that understands the world while refusing to accept its injustices as inevitable.** **Hope becomes therefore political because it refuses to accept the miseries as unavoidable, as necessary, as a permanent status quo...** **Neither certainty nor illusion.** **Hope, claims Bloch, is a disciplined fidelity to possibility.** **Let´s think with Ernst.**. \-\-\-\-\- Our philosophy meetup has been, is and will always be totally, genuinely, joyfully and Radically free, in every sense of the words. This event is joyfully and radically free.** **You are always, always, always more than welcome.** And for those who feel that would like to, and can, support this project — here is the way. That is all.

description: **Venue change = Defuse Cafe** Open Coffee Lisbon is a friendly informal networking event for entrepreneurs, professionals, locals, guests, people in the startup community, and students in Lisbon.⁣ Your host for our event will be Richard. with support from the Open Coffee Lisbon team. You may find a mentor, investor, client, co founder, employer, vendor, inspiration or a friend. Please post your contact details, a link to your Linkedin and/webpage in this group chat, and in our WhatsApp group [here ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY)https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can talk to people who are most interesting to you. We are focused on business and social entrepreneurs, the startup community and anyone else who is doing something interesting or wants to get involved in other people's projects. You can talk about any project/topic. Open Coffee Lisbon is an “un-meeting” without a speaker or agenda. We are focused on attendees gaining value from other attendees. We want to help people create useful business connections.⁣ Everyone is welcome to our meetings, and we especially love first-timers.⁣ ⁣We want to make sure that if somebody coming from an unsupportive background/country has the courage to join, they will notice that we are glad they came because we welcome them. If you feel shy, you can also just listen but we encourage you to talk. Each attendee can also get to show their LinkedIn page or website through our channels and showcase their idea.⁣ This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. If you want to help and get involved in making this gathering a regular part of the Lisbon eco-system please let us know [here](https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9) https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9 if you are interested in knowing more about the Open Coffee format, take a look at our video for potential leaders [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z99E2z8anFU). If you don't want us to do that don't give us your email. If you change your mind you can leave the Substack mailing list at any time.
